svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 961 commits across five public projects, 70 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-23 through 2026-11-14 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-14T03:38:57.332Z.
